name: tihloh/prefab-permissions
description: Standalone, framework-independent permissions with group inheritance and user overrides for Prefab PHP.

suggest.ext-pdo: Required only when using Prefab's built-in PDO/database-backed permission store.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-users: Optional user integration for permission subjects and group membership.
suggest.tihloh/prefab-logs: Optional structured activity logging for permission changes.
